_readme: Public content for the Learnings page. Articles: give each an id, title, date (ISO), category (an id from CATEGORIES in js/data.js: product, books, ai, los, underwriting, collections, lending, fintech, presales, career, data, ux), readlength (rapid | medium | long), excerpt, and either a source (HTML file under content/articles/), inline content, or a url (e.g. a Medium post). Documents: id, title, type (pdf | ppt | pptx), category, description, date, file (path under files/), optional pages.

articles.title: Five AI Capabilities in Production Lending: What Actually Moved the Needle
articles.excerpt: Eighteen months, five AI capabilities, one live lending platform. Why we started with the credit memo, measured turnaround time instead of accuracy, and designed PII handling before writing a single prompt.
